title: The Fourth, 2005 · after
logline: The morning after: Gully sweeping the dock, and Wood's stool at the counter with a coffee on it gone cold from last night, untouched, because he left early. Gully doesn't pour it out. He puts a saucer over it.

panels.composition: The dock in the morning, spent tubes, GULLY sweeping. BARNABY on the planks.

panels.composition: Inside: the end stool, a full cup of coffee on the counter before it, cold.
